shield: Read date before consulting ID, Island, Location or stage. Once within window use only those five fields; never Year, age, filled, or any later output.

definitions.source: Only IDs with a single nest Island code from pre2015 directly recorded nest observations.
definitions.first: Earliest direct capt/obs calendar date strictly later than earliest nest; contradictory same-date codes are ambiguous.
definitions.hidden_later: For first-followup SAME nest code IDs, count any strictly later direct observation date with a single DIFFERENT code.
definitions.later_return: For first-followup DIFFERENT code IDs, count any strictly later direct observation date with one code EQUAL to the nest code.
definitions.ambiguous: With no definitive later switch/return, any contradictory later date yields ambiguous status.
definitions.opportunity: A further observation opportunity is at least one direct capt/obs record on a date strictly later than the first followup.
definitions.lag: Days from first direct followup to first unambiguous different-code later observation; bins 1..30,31..365,>365. This is OBSERVATION lag, not movement time.
